STRC: the A&R CoD (effective 2026-06-30 12:01am ET; signed 2026-06-15) moved payments from monthly to semi-monthly (15th and month-end). Record dates: month-end for the 15th payment, the 15th for the month-end payment. Original CoD: record date the 15th, payment the last day of the month. Other changes: 'Monthly Regular Dividend Rate Per Annum' renamed 'Regular Dividend Rate Per Annum' and now set for 16th-to-15th periods; SOFR max-reduction lookback moved to the 3rd/2nd preceding periods; compounding is semi-monthly; accrual is 1/24 of the annual rate per half-month; the June 2026 dividend stays under the original CoD; authorized shares rose from 28,011,111 to 282,556,565; STRE added to the junior lists. Section 7(d) contains a typo, 'Perpetual Preferred Stretch Stock'.

STRC rate: cannot be negative; cannot be below One-Month Term SOFR on the business day before notice; any cut is limited to 25 bp plus the SOFR decline over the lookback; no cut is allowed while dividends are in arrears. There is no cap on increases. Rates found: 9.00% initial (2025-07-29), 11.50% for June 2026, 12.00% for record dates on or after 2026-07-01, and 12.00% for 2026-10-16 to 2026-11-15. The 2026-10-15 8-K sets 12.00% for November 2026 daily record dates if the contingent condition is met, and says management will recommend keeping 12.00% until STRC trades near $100. The files hold no full month-by-month rate history.

Pending: the DEF 14A (special meeting 2026-10-28) proposes daily record dates with payment on the next business day for STRF, STRC, STRK and STRD, not STRE. Daily dividends would start 2026-11-01 (record) / 2026-11-02 (payment) for STRC and 2027-01-01 (record) / 2027-01-04 (payment) for the others. The November 2026 STRC daily dividends ($1.00 total per share) are contingent; if the amendment passes, the declared 2026-11-15 STRC dividend is not payable. Compounding and the director triggers would be re-based to calendar quarters, or to semi-monthly periods for STRC.

STRK: the CoD filed 2025-02-05 had no 'stated amount', and the liquidation preference was a flat $100. The STRK Amendment (filed 2025-07-07, ratified by common stockholders on 2026-06-08 under DGCL s.204) added a $100 stated amount and the market-price-linked liquidation preference. CONFLICT: the 10-Q Q2 2026 preferred table still shows STRK 'Stated Amount' as 'n/a' after ratification. The FC repurchase price and dividend base use the stated amount after ratification.

STRK has no company-forced or mandatory conversion in the CoD or Ex.4.2; conversion is at the holder's option only. The STRK CoD sets no fixed STRK-specific redemption threshold in shares; the clean-up test is stated amount outstanding < $182.5M (25% of the initial issue). The STRK tax-redemption price is the greater of the liquidation preference and the 5-trading-day average price. The STRK FC repurchase right does not apply to certain all-cash Class A Stock Change Events where the conversion value is at least the repurchase price.

Liquidation preference: every series (STRE in EUR) uses the greatest of (stated amount; last sale price on the prior trading day if the company sold that series on that day or in the prior 10 trading days; 10-trading-day average last sale price). The 10-Q reports $100/EUR100 per share and aggregate LP equal to shares x 100, while footnote (1) says the LP 'generally approximates' the greater of trading price and $100. So the reported aggregate LP equals the stated notional and may understate the formula LP on days when the price is above $100.

Shares at 2026-06-30: the 10-Q note labels the row 'Shares Issued as of June 30, 2026'. The MD&A table labels the same figures (in thousands) 'Shares Outstanding': STRF 12,840; STRC 104,895; STRE 7,750; STRK 14,021; STRD 14,024. STRE aggregate LP is shown as $884,120K in USD in the note table and EUR 775,000K notional in MD&A. STRC fell to about 104.6M shares ($10.46bn) by 2026-07-24, and repurchases continued in October 2026 (1,932,145 shares in the week to Oct 11 and 1,938,780 in the week to Oct 18).

Dividend-arrears accrual differs by series: STRF and STRE compound at the regular rate + 100bp, stepping up 100bp per period to an 18% cap, and have a 60-day deferral / deferred payment date mechanism. STRK compounds quarterly at a flat 8%. STRC compounds semi-monthly at its current rate. STRD is NON-cumulative: no compounding, and redemption and FC prices include only declared dividends. Only STRF and STRK carry director-election rights (4 and 8 consecutive missed quarters); STRC, STRE and STRD have none.

Protection against new senior stock: only STRF requires a majority consent to issue senior stock. STRC, STRE, STRK and STRD allow it without consent; STRC's CoD expressly deems creating Dividend/Liquidation Senior Stock not adverse.

Minor inconsistencies: the Ex.4.2 STRD ranking bullet parenthetical names only STRF, STRC and STRK as senior, but the next sentence and the 10-Q add STRE. The STRD CoD (June 2025) lists only STRK and STRF as senior, and the STRK CoD (Feb 2025) lists none. Later series made themselves senior through their own 'expressly provide' terms. The STRE CoD ranking clause and the STRC/STRF/STRK/STRE CoD Section 4 clauses do not mention indebtedness; subordination to debt comes from Ex.4.2 (STRF/STRK/STRD) and the 10-Q risk factor. STRE is not described in Ex.4.2 because it is not Section 12-registered; it lists on LuxSE. FC repurchase and redemption accrual for STRC run 'to, and including' the date; for the others 'to, but excluding'. STRC's minimum redemption notice is 3 business days, versus 15 calendar days for the others.

Not found: a month-by-month STRC rate history; exact shares outstanding after June 2026 for each series; any STRE-specific listing clause in the CoD (listing comes from the 10-Q table and the 8-K 'LuxSE: STRE'). STRF/STRD/STRE optional redemption is a clean-up call only, with no par call date, and none of the five has a maturity.
